switzerland.title: Flag of Switzerland

colors.note: Represents peace; forms the Swiss cross with equilateral arms

desc:
- A white cross on a red square field — one of only two square sovereign flags
- The design dates to the Old Swiss Confederacy and was formally standardised in 1841
- **Construction:** a square red field (1:1 ratio, unique among national flags along with Vatican City)
- A white equilateral Greek cross is centred, each arm one-sixth longer than it is wide
- The cross extends to within 1/6 of each edge
trivia:
- The Swiss flag and the Vatican flag are the only two square sovereign-state flags
- The white cross represents neutrality and independence
- Switzerland's flag has remained unchanged since 1841
